row:
Want to feel better in your body? How you feel tomorrow, starts today!
Physiotherapists, Chiropractors & Massage Therapists: we feel that YOUR success is our success!
Inclusive, safe, welcoming.
Physiotherapists, Chiropractors & RMTs with extensive experience with strains/sprains, complex injuries and prevention to provide you with the best care possible, based on a detailed assessment.
We focus on active, exercise-based rehabilitation with education, manual therapy and taping to help you recover faster. Acupuncture, Shockwave, bracing, compression, Orthotics, ultrasound, IFC, TENS.
Our gym has a treadmill, bikes, weights/bands, balance equipment to try your customized rehab exercises before doing at home.
Private Treatment Rooms
Pelvic Floor Physio - Certified Hand Physio - Acupuncture - TCM
We take post-grad education to learn new techniques to help you. 
You will receive the highest level of care on an individual basis.
Southwest Mississauga's best Physiotherapists & Chiropractors
